انحبسوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَبَسُوا (inḥabasū) /in.ħa.ba.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# اِنْحَبِسُوا (inḥabisū) /in.ħa.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
